title: Enquiry
text: Send your enquiry by email or the booking form, with your preferred date, location and service.

title: Consultation
text: I check my availability. Bespoke or larger projects get a short call; smaller projects are arranged by email.

title: Final quote
text: You receive a digital contract and invoice. A 30% non-refundable deposit secures your booking (50% for websites).

title: Confirmation
text: Once the signed contract and deposit arrive, your booking is confirmed and I keep you updated at every step.

title: Delivery
text: You receive your images, designs or website within the agreed turnaround. Full payment is due 48 hours after delivery (at launch for websites).
